method: Four nonoverlapping seven-day UTC submission windows. Use the union of the two new arXiv subject queries and deduplicate version-independent arXiv identifiers. Check primary listings for July, August and September and look up v1 dates to handle later announcement. Cross-listed coverage is counted against the original sixteen subjects.

For both July controls, enumerate every original arXiv identifier in fourteen independent daily queries and compare with each dated store. The second arm restores the complete corresponding control. Classification hints, review policy and ranking weights are shared. APS abstracts and CC BY eligibility are checked against the publisher on the same dates.

Trace each introduced July paper from relevance screening to initial candidate, first and second review and final rank. Sample up to five ranks from each end with added evidence and the first five wholly excluded initial candidates with added papers per date, in sorted full-paper-ID order. Review primary source evidence, observable, type of result, byline and the dated English copy. A repeated rank counts once. August has source measurements and archived sixteen-subject ranks only.

The intake date is the first submission in UTC. The arXiv API includes the currently indexed revision in a retrospective collection. All 44 newly discoverable papers were separately checked against their original v1 landing page. Revisions after a cutoff can affect historical wording.

paper_results.arxiv:2607.25774: A theory describes the interaction between molecules in different rotational and vibrational states and its implications for collision loss.
paper_results.arxiv:2607.25777: Calculations predict tunable state-dependent interactions and collision stability in molecular mixtures.
paper_results.arxiv:2607.25783: The proposed array-loading scheme predicts the occupied fraction of molecular tweezers.
paper_results.arxiv:2609.20286: An optical-lattice model calculates Hubbard interaction parameters for shielded molecules.

excluded_cases.assessment: The experimental cross sections, predicted molecular interaction parameters, tweezer occupancy and lattice parameters answer different questions. The review chapter adds no independent measurement. Five papers share one author, and three companion calculations should not be counted as three independent confirmations.
excluded_cases.reviewed_by: One source-based editorial check against original arXiv records, after the automated grouping decision.

paper_results.arxiv:2607.26499: The nuclear spectroscopy calculation evaluates the effect of collective deformation on low-energy states.
paper_results.arxiv:2607.26546: The mirror-pair calculation examines differences in nuclear excitation energies.
paper_results.arxiv:2607.26800: The many-body calculation examines hypernuclear radii, separation energies and density profiles.
paper_results.arxiv:2607.26961: The shell-model study compares light hypernuclear binding energies, spectra and densities.
paper_results.arxiv:2607.27096: The ionic calculation assesses uncertainty in a correction to the bound-electron magnetic moment.

excluded_cases.assessment: Two papers compare properties of hypernuclei. The other studies address ordinary nuclear deformation, mirror-state energy differences and an electronic magnetic moment. Three independent sources do not report the same quantity in comparable systems.
excluded_cases.reviewed_by: One source-based editorial check against original arXiv records, after the automated grouping decision.

source_type_check.decision: The first-stage field screen admitted an explicitly retrospective review chapter. It contributed no ranked evidence. This case remains a source-type calibration example for the original-research policy.

editorial_review.interpretation: These four exclusions can be evaluated. The sample provides zero new-paper ranked headlines or summaries to grade and does not establish upper- or lower-rank accuracy.

costs.basis: Differences between cumulative model ledgers along each independent restore chain. The earlier August runs are already accounted for. These historical costs do not estimate the monthly service budget.

decision: Retain the two additional source queries in the on-demand Physics pilot. Public Physics continues with its four subjects. Release assessment still requires independently checked ranked and excluded cases and the shared 14-date operating-cost record. Set the aggregate monthly budget using the pilot measurements.
